verdict.rationale: Marqeta's own docs say its developer documentation includes interactive widgets for exploring and testing the Core API directly in the browser, which directly addresses an interactive, runnable API reference. That rests on a single thin claim, with no detail on per-endpoint examples, code samples, or how the widgets work. A sandbox exists for running calls, but no hands-on or independent check confirms the widgets. missing for 10: documented per-endpoint runnable code examples, detail on how the widgets execute requests (e.g., against sandbox credentials), an accessible machine-readable OpenAPI spec backing the reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Marqeta's developer documentation includes interactive widgets that you can use to explore and test the Core API directly from your browser.
The Marqeta platform provides a sandbox environment where you can explore the capabilities of the Core API.
